description: This file defines the 'BuzzService' class within the OrangeHRM system, providing business logic related to 'buzz' posts and comments, including permission checks and DAO access methods.

classes.name: BuzzService
classes.description: Main service class providing methods to manage 'buzz' posts and comments permissions and access to DAO objects.

methods.name: getBuzzDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of BuzzDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of BuzzLikeDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to update a specific buzz feed post owned by the given employee number.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to delete a specific buzz feed post owned by the given employee number.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to update a specific buzz comment owned by the given employee number.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to delete a specific buzz comment owned by the given employee number.
